parts.title: Prolegomena
parts.description: “Things said beforehand”—the assumptions and presuppositions in back of theology, including epistemology, bibliology, and hermeneutics

parts.title: Theology proper
parts.description: The study of the nature and attributes of God, including the divine decrees and God’s works of creation and providence

parts.title: Cosmology
parts.description: The study of created things, of the heavens and the earth, of angels and demons

parts.title: Anthropology
parts.description: The study of man as he relates to God and to his fellow men

parts.title: Christology
parts.description: The study of Christ, especially his incarnation and the redemption he accomplished

parts.title: Soteriology
parts.description: The study of salvation applied to sinners

parts.title: Ecclesiology
parts.description: The study of the church, including the sub-discipline of sacramentology

parts.title: Eschatology
parts.description: “Last things”—death, the end of the world, final judgment, the ultimate destiny of humanity

parts.title: Topical studies
parts.description: Miscellaneous topics that don’t quite fit elsewhere
